3.translation_description: Metti in stalla il mio chocobo

7.name: TEXT_CMNDEFHOUSINGBUDDYSTABLE_00201_MAIN_MENU_LEAVE_MY_CHOCOBO
7.translation_description: Metti in stalla il mio chocobo

8.name: TEXT_CMNDEFHOUSINGBUDDYSTABLE_00201_MAIN_MENU_CONFIRM_CLEAN
8.description: Use a magicked stable broom to clean the stable?
8.translation_description: Vuoi usare una scopa magica per pulire la stalla?

11.name: TEXT_CMNDEFHOUSINGBUDDYSTABLE_00201_MAIN_MENU_CONFIRM_LEAVE
11.translation_description: Vuoi mettere in stalla il tuo chocobo?

21.name: TEXT_CMNDEFHOUSINGBUDDYSTABLE_00201_EXPLAIN_TRAIN_A1
21.description: It is possible to train your chocobo while he is stabled. Doing so will grant him Companion EXP. To train a chocobo, you must first prepare <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>feed<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> to use as a <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>treat<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.
21.translation_description: Puoi addestrare il tuo chocobo mentre si trova nella stalla. In questo modo otterrà ESP Compagno. Per addestrarlo, devi prima preparare del <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>mangime<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> da usare come <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>premietto<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.

22.name: TEXT_CMNDEFHOUSINGBUDDYSTABLE_00201_EXPLAIN_TRAIN_A2
22.description: After training, you must allow your chocobo to rest and recuperate before he can be trained again.
22.translation_description: Dopo l’addestramento, dovrai lasciare che il chocobo riposi e recuperi le forze prima di poterlo addestrare di nuovo.

23.name: TEXT_CMNDEFHOUSINGBUDDYSTABLE_00201_EXPLAIN_TRAIN_A3
23.description: When your chocobo has accumulated the maximum amount of Companion EXP for his current rank, you may increase his rank through battle.
23.translation_description: Quando il chocobo avrà accumulato il massimo di ESP Compagno previsto per il suo grado attuale, potrai aumentare il suo grado combattendo.

24.name: TEXT_CMNDEFHOUSINGBUDDYSTABLE_00201_EXPLAIN_TRAIN_A4
24.description: Additionally, if your chocobo has already attained the maximum rank, you can feed him a Thavnairian onion following training to increase this upper limit.
24.translation_description: Inoltre, se il chocobo ha già raggiunto il grado massimo, dopo l’addestramento puoi dargli una cipolla thavnairiana per aumentare il limite.

25.name: TEXT_CMNDEFHOUSINGBUDDYSTABLE_00201_EXPLAIN_TRAIN_A5
25.description: It is also possible to train others' chocobos if you have the authority to do so. However, please note that you cannot raise the maximum rank of others' chocobos, nor can you influence their feed preferences.
25.translation_description: Se hai l’autorizzazione, puoi anche addestrare i chocobo altrui. Ricorda, però, che non puoi aumentare il loro grado massimo né influenzare le loro preferenze alimentari.

26.name: TEXT_CMNDEFHOUSINGBUDDYSTABLE_00201_EXPLAIN_TRAIN_A6
26.description: Chocobos must rest and recuperate between your training sessions. However, because they react positively to new stimulation, other members can train the same chocobo during this period─after which they will have to wait before they can do so again.
26.translation_description: Tra una sessione di addestramento e l’altra, il chocobo deve riposare e recuperare le forze. Tuttavia, reagisce bene agli stimoli nuovi: durante questo periodo, un altro membro può addestrarlo; dopo, dovrà aspettare prima di farlo di nuovo.

27.name: TEXT_CMNDEFHOUSINGBUDDYSTABLE_00201_EXPLAIN_TRAIN_B1
27.description: Certain types of feed may be used to grant beneficial effects to your chocobo when he is summoned to battle.
27.translation_description: Alcuni tipi di mangime conferiscono al chocobo effetti benefici quando viene evocato in battaglia.

28.name: TEXT_CMNDEFHOUSINGBUDDYSTABLE_00201_EXPLAIN_TRAIN_B2
28.description: Such feed includes curiel roots, sylkis buds, mimett gourds, and pahsana fruits.
28.translation_description: Tra questi mangimi ci sono radici Curiel, boccioli di Sylkis, zucche Mimett e frutti Pahsana.

29.name: TEXT_CMNDEFHOUSINGBUDDYSTABLE_00201_EXPLAIN_TRAIN_B3
29.description: Should you reward a chocobo with the same feed continuously, it will become his <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>favorite feed<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, and the beneficial effects granted by it when he is deployed will be enhanced.
29.translation_description: Se ricompensi il chocobo sempre con lo stesso mangime, diventerà il suo <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Cibo Preferito<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> e gli effetti benefici ottenuti in battaglia saranno potenziati.

30.name: TEXT_CMNDEFHOUSINGBUDDYSTABLE_00201_EXPLAIN_TRAIN_B4
30.description: Additionally, when your chocobo has attained the maximum rank, feeding it a Thavnairian onion will raise this upper limit.
30.translation_description: Inoltre, quando il chocobo ha raggiunto il grado massimo, puoi dargli una cipolla thavnairiana per aumentare il limite.

31.name: TEXT_CMNDEFHOUSINGBUDDYSTABLE_00201_EXPLAIN_TRAIN_C1
31.description: It is possible to train others' chocobos if you have the authority to do so.
31.translation_description: Se hai l’autorizzazione, puoi anche addestrare i chocobo altrui.

32.name: TEXT_CMNDEFHOUSINGBUDDYSTABLE_00201_EXPLAIN_TRAIN_C2
32.description: Should you choose to share your private estate with another individual, you may grant them the authority to stable their chocobo and train others' as well.
32.translation_description: Se condividi la tua tenuta privata con un’altra persona, puoi autorizzarla a mettere in stalla il suo chocobo e ad addestrare quelli degli altri.

33.name: TEXT_CMNDEFHOUSINGBUDDYSTABLE_00201_EXPLAIN_TRAIN_C3
33.description: In the case of apartments, you can also train the chocobos of those who have a room in the same building.
33.translation_description: Negli appartamenti, puoi anche addestrare i chocobo di chi ha una stanza nello stesso edificio.

34.name: TEXT_CMNDEFHOUSINGBUDDYSTABLE_00201_EXPLAIN_TRAIN_C4
34.description: In order to train another's chocobo, a certain period of time must elapse after the creature has been stabled.
34.translation_description: Per addestrare il chocobo di un’altra persona, deve trascorrere un certo periodo da quando è stato messo in stalla.

35.name: TEXT_CMNDEFHOUSINGBUDDYSTABLE_00201_EXPLAIN_TRAIN_C5
35.description: Training conducted by the chocobo's owner as opposed to that conducted by someone else is considered separate; the recuperation time of one does not affect the other. Furthermore, you cannot raise the maximum rank of others' chocobos, nor can you influence their feed preferences.
35.translation_description: L’addestramento del proprietario e quello di un’altra persona vengono conteggiati separatamente: il tempo di recupero di uno non influisce sull’altro. Inoltre, non puoi aumentare il grado massimo dei chocobo altrui né influenzarne le preferenze alimentari.

36.name: TEXT_CMNDEFHOUSINGBUDDYSTABLE_00201_EXPLAIN_CLEAN_1
36.description: Training is more effective if a chocobo is housed in a clean stable.
36.translation_description: L’addestramento è più efficace se il chocobo si trova in una stalla pulita.

37.name: TEXT_CMNDEFHOUSINGBUDDYSTABLE_00201_EXPLAIN_CLEAN_2
37.description: Stables can be cleaned with <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>magicked stable brooms<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.
37.translation_description: Puoi pulire la stalla con delle <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>scope magiche per stalla<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.

38.name: TEXT_CMNDEFHOUSINGBUDDYSTABLE_00201_EXPLAIN_CHANGE_COLOR_A1
38.description: If you wish to change your chocobo's plumage, you may <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>feed<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> him snacks.
38.translation_description: Se vuoi cambiare il colore del piumaggio del chocobo, puoi <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>nutrirlo<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> con degli spuntini.

39.name: TEXT_CMNDEFHOUSINGBUDDYSTABLE_00201_EXPLAIN_CHANGE_COLOR_A2
39.description: Snacks include Xelphatol apples, valfruits, Mamook pears, Cieldalaes pineapples, O'Ghomoro berries, and Doman plums. Each of these snacks will affect your chocobo's plumage in different ways.
39.translation_description: Gli spuntini includono mele di Xelphatol, valfruit, pere di Mamook, ananas delle Cieldalaes, bacche di O’Ghomoro e susine di Doma. Ognuno di questi spuntini modifica in modo diverso il colore del piumaggio.

40.name: TEXT_CMNDEFHOUSINGBUDDYSTABLE_00201_EXPLAIN_CHANGE_COLOR_A3
40.description: After first feeding your chocobo, you must allow him to rest in his stable for at least six hours to ensure that his plumage changes color.
40.translation_description: Dopo aver dato da mangiare al chocobo per la prima volta, devi lasciarlo riposare nella stalla per almeno sei ore, affinché il piumaggio cambi colore.

41.name: TEXT_CMNDEFHOUSINGBUDDYSTABLE_00201_EXPLAIN_CHANGE_COLOR_A4
41.description: No change will occur if you take your chocobo out of the stable prematurely.
41.translation_description: Se lo togli dalla stalla prima del tempo, il piumaggio non cambierà.

42.name: TEXT_CMNDEFHOUSINGBUDDYSTABLE_00201_EXPLAIN_CHANGE_COLOR_B1
42.description: Feeding your chocobo a Han lemon will revert his plumage to the original yellow hue.
42.translation_description: Dando al chocobo un limone di Han, il suo piumaggio tornerà al giallo deserto.

46.name: TEXT_CMNDEFHOUSINGBUDDYSTABLE_00201_MY_CHOCOBO_RENAME
46.translation_description: Cambia il nome del mio chocobo.

53.name: TEXT_CMNDEFHOUSINGBUDDYSTABLE_00201_PROMPT_BUDDY_RENAME_TITLE
53.translation_description: Assegna un nuovo nome al tuo chocobo personale.

55.name: TEXT_CMNDEFHOUSINGBUDDYSTABLE_00201_PROMPT_BUDDY_RENAME_MES0
55.description: Names must be between 2 and 20 alphabetic characters and can include apostrophes but not hyphens.
55.translation_description: I nomi devono contenere da 2 a 20 lettere; sono ammessi gli apostrofi, ma non i trattini.

58.name: TEXT_CMNDEFHOUSINGBUDDYSTABLE_00201_PROMPT_BUDDY_RENAME_SUCCESS
58.translation_description: Il nome del tuo chocobo è stato cambiato in <hex:022903EA0203>.

59.name: TEXT_CMNDEFHOUSINGBUDDYSTABLE_00201_CONFIRM_GET_MY_CHOCOBO2
59.description: No plumage change will occur if you take your chocobo out of the stable prematurely. Are you sure you wish to do so?
59.translation_description: Se riporti fuori il chocobo prima del tempo, il suo piumaggio non cambierà. Vuoi continuare?
